judge.rationale: The candidate misses a central requirement of the issue: preserving the original non-Error rejection value as the `cause` property on the wrapped `Error` (`new Error(..., {cause: error})`). It also completely omits testing or handling the `undefined` rejection case explicitly listed in the acceptance criteria. Furthermore, its `ensureError` implementation calls `JSON.stringify(value)` unguarded, which will throw a `TypeError` on circular objects or `BigInt` values and mask the original rejection, whereas the reference safely wraps `JSON.stringify` in a `try/catch` and falls back to `String(error)`. Finally, the candidate leaves a `.lore/dod.md` scratch file in the repository and puts its test in a new separate file rather than `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts`.
